title: Special Cards Expansion & Interactive Modals
changes: Integrated all 8 official Special Cards (Lucky Find, Helping Hand, Second Chance, Borrowed Tool, Brilliant Idea, Hidden Toolbox, Wild Inspiration, Happy Accident).
Interactive SpecialCardPlayModal for card swaps, target player borrowing, custom wild declarations, and extra request selection.
Vibrant village-themed card visuals with distinct purple timing badges (Before Story, During Story, After Story).
Real-time visual indicators on the Village Board for borrowed tools, wild inspirations, and bonus requests.
Added dedicated Special Cards guide in the Rulebook modal.

title: Event-Driven Engine & Analytics
changes: Refactored game engine into pure event-sourced architecture with deterministic replay.
Added Game Analytics Engine with real-time statistics (Average Time, Popular Requests, Least Used Tools).
Added Special Cards Plugin system (Lucky Hammer, Silver Tongue).
Decoupled Socket.IO into a thin transport layer.

title: Tactile Digital Tabletop UI
changes: Tactile dark felt and polished wood design system with golden accents.
Fanned 5-card player hand dock with interactive multi-card selection.
Interactive 30-second Rulebook modal and live Village Activity Feed.
Host moderation tools for skipping AFK players and forcing phases.

title: Initial FixIT Alpha Release
changes: Core 24 Village Requests (10 Small, 10 Medium, 4 Large) and 12 Tool Cards catalog.
Authoritative Socket.IO turn lifecycle: Turn -> Storytelling -> Discussion -> Voting -> Results.
Room creation with 6-character room codes and shareable invitation links.
